fareRules.title: I5E
fareRules.text:
Xpress Value - (Domestic)

Change
INR 3500/- Per pax Per Sector 2hrs prior to Departure date + Fare difference


Cancellation INR 5000/- Per pax Per Sector 2 hours prior to the departure.
In EXPRESS RETURN fare one sector cancellation not permitted as per airline.


Note:
Changes and Cancellations are permitted upto 2 hrs before scheduled flight departure. Fare difference, if any, would be applicable.

*Fare rule is applicable for Tickets issued on & after 04th Nov'25
*Incase of cancellation all chargeable SSR / Ancillary service is Non refundable
* In EXPRESS RETURN fare one sector cancellation not permitted as per airline.
* Facilitation Fee of Rs.100 per passenger per flight - for Tele Check-in done at Reservations.The fee will be applicable to all new and existing bookings.
* An Additional Sum of Rs.250 per passenger per flight for flight change / booking cancellation processed via Reservations/Corproatedesk and Airport Ticketing Counters.
* Promotional fares are Non Changeable and Non-Refundable in case of cancellation.
* In friends and family fare minimum of two (02) and maximum of nine (09) passengers can be booked under this fare and in case of cancellation & Partial Reissuance minimum of 2/4 passenger has to be in the PNR.
* Partial cancellation is not allowed on tickets booked under Special/GoReturn & discounted fares.
* In case of no-show or ticket not cancelled within the stipulated time only statutory taxes are refundable.
* Partial cancellation is not allowed if the ticket is bought in Round-trip special fare.
* The above Fare Rules are just for your guideline and is subject to changes by the Airline without prior notice. We will try to keep this section updated regularly, We undertakes no liability for loss that you may suffer due to incorrect information.
